name: G. H. Zirngebel
mentions: Postmaster Harbison, G. H. Zirngebel and Geo. E. Scales, of Belfield, attended the sale here Monday. The latter chartered a flat-car or something and brought along the prize potato of the season. It was rai…

…the Norman stallion. The rest were bid in by M. Wadsworth, Link Gates, Jim Harmon, T. R. Selmes and Messers. Zirngebel and Scales of Belfield. As stated the horses brought fair prices but they were good animals and we doubt if there is a purchaser who is dissatisfied with his bargain.
